address: 57 Minzhi Street, Yonghe District, New Taipei, Taiwan
bio: Popular among locals for its breakfast since 2016, this spot appeals to regulars with cordial service and rustic, traditional flavours. In the food sector for 20+ years, the owner makes the soya milk, flatbread, egg crepe rolls and xiao long bao himself. His signature pastry bun filled with spring onion and peppered pork satisfies with its bouncy texture and aromatic filling. Ask the owner when the freshly baked flatbread is due out of the oven.
